about:
Quality Plastics & Machine, Incorporated was founded in 1976 in Sparks, Nevada. The company began as a custom plastics fabricator and has since expanded into a multi-process manufacturing operation.

The shop’s core process is vacuum forming, where rigid thermoplastic sheets are heated and drawn over tooling, complemented by drape forming for optically clear curved parts. In-house capabilities include CNC machining of both plastic and metal parts on machining centers and a dual-spindle lathe with live tooling, five-axis and three-axis CNC routing, laser cutting, and 3D printing for prototypes and fixtures. A fabrication department handles trimming, hardware installation, riveting, threaded fasteners, and inserts, while a turnkey production group manages full builds from part production through electro-mechanical assembly. The company also designs and builds custom automated machines to accelerate production.

Quality Plastics serves laboratories, medical equipment manufacturers, display and electronics firms, motor vehicle and entertainment industries, agriculture, watercraft, and aerospace programs; its parts have flown on multiple space shuttle missions.

The company states its competitive advantage lies in assisting customers with product design, creating tooling, and delivering quality products on time, backed by process controls that minimize warp and improve dimensional stability after forming or machining.
